title: Quercetin targeted NF-kappaB to regulate platelet activation and prevent arterial thrombosis.
authors: Wang, Wenli; Li, Yanmei; Liu, Yanyan; Sun, Zhangping; Zhao, Bingiie; Song, Fubo
one_liner_zh: 该文研究槲皮素通过NF-kappaB通路抑制血小板活化与抗血栓，虽涉及分子对接但核心是药物-蛋白作用，非蛋白质-DNA互作或TF-DNA结合建模，与本课题关联弱。
abstract: While the inactivation effect of quercetin on platelets has been widely studied, the underlying mechanisms remained insufficiently explored. This research examined how quercetin inactivated platelets and helps to prevent thrombosis. We validated quercetin's inhibitory effects on platelet activation by CRP and collagen. We also investigated how quercetin regulated the NF-kappaB pathway during platelet activation and its potential impact on this process. To validate in vitro results, we created an in vivo arterial thrombus model using FeCl(3) and observed thrombus formation after quercetin administration. Quercetin inhibited platelet activation by CRP and collagen, reduced aggregation rate, and suppressed adhesion to collagen surface. This effect was linked to the NF-kappaB pathway. The in vitro results were validated in a FeCl(3)-induced carotid artery thrombosis model. The effects of quercetin, as previously mentioned, were observed to be dose-dependent. Furthermore, the essential function of the NF-kappaB signaling pathway in this process has been substantiated. NF-kappaB was the drug target of quercetin. However, the inhibitory effect of quercetin was attenuated when the NF-kappaB pathway was pre-activated. Our study confirmed the antiplatelet and antithrombotic effects of quercetin. This study not only confirmed that quercetin exerted its antithrombotic effects by inhibiting the NF-kappaB pathway but also, more importantly, clearly identified NF-kappaB p65 as a direct target of quercetin through molecular docking and DARTS assays.
abstract_zh: 尽管槲皮素对血小板的灭活作用已被广泛研究，但其潜在机制仍未得到充分探索。本研究探讨了槲皮素如何灭活血小板并有助于预防血栓形成。我们验证了槲皮素对CRP和胶原诱导的血小板激活的抑制作用。我们还研究了槲皮素在血小板激活过程中如何调节NF-kappaB通路及其对该过程的潜在影响。为验证体外结果，我们利用FeCl(3)建立了体内动脉血栓模型，并观察了槲皮素给药后血栓的形成情况。槲皮素抑制了CRP和胶原诱导的血小板激活，降低了聚集率，并抑制了血小板对胶原表面的粘附。这一效应与NF-kappaB通路相关。体外结果在FeCl(3)诱导的颈动脉血栓模型中得到了验证。如前所述，槲皮素的作用呈剂量依赖性。此外，NF-kappaB信号通路在此过程中的关键功能已得到证实。NF-kappaB是槲皮素的药物靶点。然而，当NF-kappaB通路被预先激活时，槲皮素的抑制作用减弱。我们的研究确认了槲皮素的抗血小板和抗血栓作用。本研究不仅证实了槲皮素通过抑制NF-kappaB通路发挥其抗血栓作用，更重要的是，通过分子对接 (molecular docking) 和DARTS实验明确鉴定出NF-kappaB p65为槲皮素的直接靶点。
